messages.author: 0600694caf57b8fb
messages.subject: mapping variables by transparency ?
parts:
Hi,
is there a way to map a variable by degree of transparency/lightness
of the color? In the following example, I want to map var2 by
intensity, not by shape:

library("ggplot2")
df1<-data.frame(x=c(1,2),y=c(1,1),var1="a",var2=T)
df2<-data.frame(x=c(1,2),y=c(2,2),var1="b",var2=T)
df3<-data.frame(x=c(4,5),y=c(7,8),var1="b",var2=F)
df<-rbind(df1,df2,df3)

p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,color=var1,shape=var2))
p<-p+geom_point()
p


but something like

p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,color=var1,alpha=var2))

does not work (Error: Continuous variable (var2) supplied to discrete
scale_shape)

Thanks.


--
Daniel Linares
web: www.dlinares.org

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: mapping variables by transparency ?
parts:
When I run your code the error I get is:

"Error: Non-continuous variable supplied to scale_alpha_alpha."

The solution to which is pretty clear (excuse the pun):

df$var2=as.numeric(df$var2)
p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,color=var1,alpha=var2))
p+geom_point()

p<-p+geom_point()+ scale_shape_manual(value=c(16,17))

but something like scale_alpha_manual does not exits. Any idea about
how i can do it?

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: mapping variables by transparency ?
parts:
Try this,

scale_alpha_manual <- ScaleManual$build_accessor(list(variable = "\"alpha\""))

p<-ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y,color=var1,alpha=var2))
p<-p+geom_point()+ scale_alpha_manual(value=c(0.5,0.9))
p

HTH,

baptiste
